items.title: Micah Parsons: Making return to practice Wednesday
items.text:
Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said that Parsons (knee) will be designated for return from the PUP list and will take part in individual work during Wednesday's practice, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: No timetable for return
items.text:
When asked Wednesday when Pierce (heel) might be able to resume to practice, Colts head coach Shane Steichen noted that he "can't put a timetable on it right now," Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Garrett Wilson: In the NFL's concussion protocol
